primary_hypothesis: In regimes with positive oracle VOA, a same-model closed-loop policy can use a released cue to choose a better next acquisition than the best acquisition committed before that cue.
primary_objective: terminal decision loss after one required acquisition

assumptions: the reset cue and acquisition likelihoods are public
all acquisition actions have equal declared cost
the runner requires exactly one acquisition and then a final answer
adaptive STOP is unavailable in the primary routing condition
identifiers are opaque and action presentation order is counterbalanced
